hypothesis: Lossless compact TF32 staging, direct tensor-core fragment stores, and vector gate prefetch with unchanged FP32 addition order reduce GDN preparation cost while preserving every compared output bit.
independent_variable: Only GDN preparation implementation: original float32 staging/WMMA versus three-byte TF32 component planes and explicit m16n8k4 (matching baseline HMMA.1684 accumulation) TF32 MMA, one-time RNA conversion, vector-prefetched sequential gate sum, fused normalized/decayed QK stores, and direct packed BF16 U/W writes. Shared allocation drops from 92 KiB to 72 KiB; no accumulator or workspace dtype/shape/API changes.

fixed_controls.inputs: Seeded synthetic correlated Q/K and weak-decay gates; representative workload shapes, not captured model activations. F64 reference test also exercises grouped heads and chunk/tile edges. New recurrent-reference checks include near-zero (amplitude 1e-9) and zero Q/K. Recurrent test includes Q/K amplitude 1e-18 to exercise the full exponent range.
fixed_controls.stream: same eager submission on default stream

run_budget: Run all 3 registered GPU tests once before timing. One excluded feasibility and 10 excluded warmups per shape/arm, then exactly two measured passes of 100 calls; reverse arm order for pass 2. No extra measured repetitions. Feasibility includes workspace diagnostics; no hardware stall/occupancy attribution from these timings.

acceptance.fidelity: All 3 existing GPU tests (GDN float64 reference tolerance unchanged) pass. All initialized compared workspace fields (u/w/qd/kd/pb/decay) and final GDN outputs match baseline bitwise in feasibility probes. Final model gate remains unchanged decisions and max probability drift <= 0.01.
acceptance.latency: >=10% lower complete GDN call latency at 936 and 3399 tokens in both measured passes, with no 107-token regression, motivates E2E. CUDA event span includes host submission bubbles.
acceptance.later_e2e_gate: >=2% lower mean warm HTTP latency, both candidate passes faster, same 74 decisions, max probability delta <= 0.01.

stop: Stop immediately on validation failure, numerical rejection, 30 minute timeout, or completion of declared budget.
compiler: CUDA 13.0 nvcc; identical ABI4 sources/options except GDN translation unit; main ABI3 validation library for Rust tests. Baseline reused byte-for-byte from the previous frozen comparison; copy time and original compilation metadata recorded separately.
command: Open-Jev lossless packed TF32 K4 GDN comparison

previous_candidate.result: K8 feasibility failed bitwise checks; no measured runs. This candidate restores the original K4 accumulation order.
